description: Create a new annotation (human review / labeling) for an LLM call. Specify at least one of annotationText / label / qualityScore (an "empty annotation" gets 400 from the backend). Example phrasing: "Claude, label this call 'badly-summarized' with quality 2", or bulk-apply positive / negative labels for an eval loop. Combined with the eval baseline runner (run_eval), annotations can calibrate eval criteria as ground truth.

annotationText.description: Free-form comment (0-2000 chars). Length is validated by the backend

label.description: Label (0-50 chars, alphanumerics plus _ - only). Usable as a dashboard filter

name: create_annotation
